items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Howard McGhee – all those guys were such a big part of the Chicago scene, because they were all coming to Chicago all the time.

ctx.x: . . . yeah, Howard McGhee – all those guys were such a big part of the Chicago scene, because they were all coming to Chicago all the time. They almost all of them dissipated around the same time.
That’s true, all in the early ’50s.
